title: Counting inequality for list decoding
statement:
Fix an integer alphabet size $q \ge 2$, a real number $p$, and integers $n$ and $L \ge 1$. Set the rate
\[
r \;=\; 1 - H_q(p) - \frac{1}{L},
\]
and define
\[
M \;=\; \bigl\lfloor q^{\,r n} \bigr\rfloor,
\qquad
V \;=\; \bigl\lfloor q^{\,H_q(p)\, n} \bigr\rfloor .
\]
Assume that $0 < M \le q^n$ and $L < M$. Then
\[
q^n \cdot \binom{V}{L+1} \cdot \binom{q^n - (L+1)}{\,M - (L+1)\,}
\;<\;
\binom{q^n}{M}.
\]
replaced:
For the choice $r = 1-H_q(\rho)-1/L$, $M=\lfloor q^{rn}\rfloor$, and
$V=\lfloor q^{H_q(\rho)n}\rfloor$, whenever $L<M\le q^n$,
\[
q^n\cdot\tbinom{V}{L+1}\cdot\tbinom{q^n-(L+1)}{M-(L+1)}
\;<\;
\tbinom{q^n}{M}.
\]
